meaning: The main screen on a phone, where your app icons sit. You can arrange them in rows and put them in folders.
clues: It is a place where your apps wait for you.
It shows small pictures called icons, and you tap one to open an app.
You can drag the icons around, make folders, and add more pages by swiping sideways.
Pressing the home button or swiping up from the bottom of the phone takes you back to it.
It has two words. The first is where you live, and the second is what you look at.
assumes: A lock screen shows before you unlock the phone
A home page is the first page a web browser opens
A taskbar is a strip of buttons at the bottom of a computer screen

decoys.meaning: The screen that shows when you wake your phone. It stays shut until you unlock it.
The first web page that opens when you start a web browser.
A strip of buttons at the bottom of a computer screen that shows the programs you have open.

exchange.text: Tip: touch and hold an icon to move it. Put the apps you use most on the first page.
